subject: Fix build error for unit test (#473)
reason: The change only edits src/Makefile to add missing static libraries (libhiredis.a, liblua.a, libhdrhistogram.a) to the link command for the valkey-unit-tests binary, fixing a build/link error for the unit test target. It changes no server code, no command behavior, no replication, persistence, or tool output; the valkey-server and tool binaries are built identically on both sides. This is a build/CI fix with no runtime behavior to exercise, so no scenario is needed.
